# UNSWEEP

> Self-service tool to diagnose a compromised EVM wallet (for example one drained by a sweeper bot or with a malicious EIP-7702 delegation) and to rescue remaining ERC-20 tokens in a single locally signed transaction.

## Scope by network
- Base: rescue of 16 verified tokens.
- Arbitrum: rescue of 12 verified tokens.
- Other ERC-20 tokens: may be detected, without guarantee.
- Ethereum: read-only diagnostic, no rescue.
- Funds already taken cannot be recovered. NFTs are not rescued.
- A 100,000 USD limit applies to eligibility; it is an eligibility limit, not a guarantee.

## Free diagnostic
- https://unsweep.com/ : free read-only diagnostic (no keys, no signatures)
